versions.added: Versioned evidence-conscious successor to V9.21. Preserves 7,775 frozen DESNZ Q3 original project identities, official source status and every MAP link; adds event-aware RSS dedupe, honest empty/partial/stale/failed/snapshot health, publisher versus collection dates, and guarded project-signals candidates without false verified claims. Browser tests include 390/393/1440; real GridAtlas engine computed a limited three-class sample, not fleet-wide.
known_faults: Three example real MAP-to-GridAtlas nearest calculations passed in a sampled run, but 390px GridAtlas can intermittently minimise the solar result card after first restore; this is not proof of a failed engine computation or fleet-wide reliability.

Project/news associations remain possible algorithmic matches. Original publisher byte receipts, specific REPD event binding and independent legal reuse have not been certified; the reader must not claim verified new project events.

Owner authorised a known-issues release: REPD 2470 at 390px re-minimised after 5.3 seconds in the 24-case real GridAtlas browser test (23/24 PASS). The mobile fix, full 24/24 acceptance and physical iPhone review are deferred to V9.23, not represented as green.
